title: Matching test phase transition
statement: Let $x$ be a binary word and let $i<|x|$, and suppose the bit of the reversal of $x$ at position $i$ equals the bit of $x$ at position $i$. One step from the test configuration with input head at position $i+1$, work head at integer position $|x|-1-i$, and the first $|x|$ bits copied yields the test configuration with input head at position $i+2$ and work head at integer position $|x|-1-(i+1)$, with the same copied work tape and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: The reversal bit at position $i$ equals the bit of $x$ at position $i$
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary word of length $n$ and $i < n$, and suppose the $i$-th bit of
the reversal $x^{R}$ equals the $i$-th bit of $x$. From the test-state
configuration of the palindrome machine on input $x$ with input head at cell
$i+1$, all $n$ bits copied, and work head at the integer cell $n-1-i$, one
transition advances the opposing heads: the input head moves right to cell $i+2$
and the work head moves left to cell $n-1-(i+1)$, with state and work tape
unchanged.
